claim: Patchline ships a verified-by-construction DSL extension mechanism with macro-hygiene proofs. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the macro-hygiene claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make macro-hygiene-dsl-extension-gate`.
